Thompson |asst_coach4= |stadium=[[Jersey Mike's Arena]] |champion= |tourney=[[2022 NCAA Division I men's basketball tournament|NCAA tournament]] |tourney_result=First Four }} {{2021–22 Big Ten Conference men's basketball standings}} The '''2021–22 Rutgers Scarlet Knights men's basketball team''' represented [[Rutgers University–New Brunswick]] during the [[2021–22 NCAA Division I men's basketball season]]. The Scarlet Knights were led by sixth-year head coach [[Steve Pikiell]] and played their home games at [[Jersey Mike's Arena]] in [[Piscataway, New Jersey]] as members of the [[Big Ten Conference]]. They finished the season 18–14, 12–8 in [[2021–22 Big Ten Conference men's basketball season|Big Ten]] play to finish a three-way tie for fourth place. As the No. 4 seed in the [[2022 Big Ten men's basketball tournament|Big Ten tournament]], they lost in the quarterfinals to [[2021–22 Iowa Hawkeyes men's basketball team|Iowa]]. The Knights received an at-large bid to the [[2022 NCAA Division I men's basketball tournament|NCAA tournament]] for the second consecutive year as a No. 11 seed in the West region. There they lost in the First Four to [[2021–22 Notre Dame Fighting Irish men's basketball team|Notre Dame]] in double overtime. ==Previous season== In a season limited due to the ongoing [[COVID-19 pandemic in the United States|COVID-19 pandemic]], the [[2020–21 Rutgers Scarlet Knights men's basketball team|Knights]] finished the [[2020–21 NCAA Division I men's basketball season|2020–21 season]] 16–12, 10–10 in [[2020–21 Big Ten Conference men's basketball season|Big Ten play]] to finish in a tie for sixth place. As the No. 7 seed in the [[2021 Big Ten men's basketball tournament|Big Ten tournament]], they defeated [[2020–21 Indiana Hoosiers men's basketball team|Indiana]] in the second round before losing to [[2020–21 Illinois Fighting Illini men's basketball team|Illinois]] in the quarterfinals. They received an at-large bid to the [[2021 NCAA Division I men's basketball tournament|NCAA tournament]], their first NCAA Tournament appearance since [[1991 NCAA Division I men's basketball tournament|1991]]. As the No. 10 seed in the Midwest region, they defeated [[2020–21 Clemson Tigers men's basketball team|Clemson]] in the first round before losing to [[2020–21 Houston Cougars men's basketball team|Houston]] in the second round. ==Offseason== ===Departures=== {| class="wikitable sortable" border="1" !
